urls.title: URLs to check
urls.description: Public HTTP(S) URLs or bare domains. Bare domains use HTTPS. Duplicate normalized URLs are checked once. Query strings are kept: two URLs that differ only by query are checked separately.

expectedStatusCodes.title: Expected HTTP status codes
expectedStatusCodes.description: Health rule: the response is healthy only when its final status code is in this list. Leave empty for the default HTTP 200-399 rule.

maxResponseTimeMs.title: Maximum healthy response time (ms)
maxResponseTimeMs.description: Health rule: a response slower than this is marked slow_response. Leave empty to disable.

maxItems.title: Maximum URLs to check
maxItems.description: Input cap: only the first N unique URLs are checked. The coverage summary reports the rest.

concurrency.title: Concurrent checks
concurrency.description: How many URLs are probed in parallel.

cacheMinutes.title: Cache window (minutes)
cacheMinutes.description: A fresh observation from another run within this window is reused for free and marked fromCache. The cache key includes the health rules. Zero disables the cache.

timeBudgetSeconds.title: Time budget (seconds)
timeBudgetSeconds.description: Upper bound on the checking phase. When it is exhausted, the coverage summary reports omitted_by_time_budget. Leave empty for the default.
